items.title: X post from @laurogeitabat: Q: how satisfied are you? oscar: pretty happy! i think that was more or less all we could've do…

items.summary: Q: how satisfied are you? oscar: pretty happy! i think that was more or less all we could've done. it's very tricky on a sprint weekend to get all the lap time out of the car here. i was struggling on the medium but once i put the soft on i was pretty happy. not a bad effort! https://t.co/CO6Yi83UU4
